input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: sensing-selfcal milestone 6b (programme draw): renders of the real views from a known camera to say which corner localiser is right

errors.what: First ablation run (four surrounds, full squares) gave identical cornerSubPix numbers for every surround, which looked like a bug.
errors.fix: Checked the renders directly: the surround was more than 22 px from every corner, so the window never saw it. That led to measuring how far the real board's end squares reach.

errors.what: outer.py ran past the 120 s foreground timeout with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.

doc_friction.issue: The pyenv.py line suggests `-r <project>/requirements.txt`. That worked, but it printed the interpreter path only after installing into /usr/bin/python3.13, and pytest was listed twice. A minor issue; nothing was lost.
The README stacks milestone headlines and figures before the milestone sections, out of numeric order (6, 4c, 4b, 4). Finding where a new milestone goes took a few greps.

deviations.why: The plan named the matched noise as 'the rms of a Laplacian, rescaled to a pixel sigma'. Because JPEG and area sampling change both statistics, I calibrated the render's blur and noise inputs so that the renders' measured statistics equal the real images' instead.
deviations.did: A grid plus linear interpolation in run.py, done before any localiser was scored on a render; the result is recorded in calib.json and the README.
deviations.result: Edge sigma matched to 0.003 px, noise to 0.02 grey levels.

deviations.why: After H33 was refuted I added unplanned diagnostics: crops of the worst real corners, an outer-square reach measurement, and a half-width ablation.
deviations.did: Reported them as unscored and not pre-registered in LOG, README, the card and the post.
deviations.result: They found the cause (half-width end squares), which reproduces the real f bias of both localisers in sign and size.

goal: Advance the sensing-selfcal programme with a ground-truth answer to milestone 6's open question.
notes: H33-H37 pre-registered and pushed before any render was made (first commit of PR #15322). One held (H37), four were refuted. Verification run here: pytest tests/ (25 passed, including 4 new render tests), research/_homepage/build.py ok, research_live_links --write, check_md_links ok, programme_check ok, and the post front-matter and links checks pass. No agent doc in docs/reports: the LOG and the README's next steps carry what the next run needs (redo milestones 3 and 4c on 5x5 corners).
